2026-11-04-am.topic: Deposit due when the estimate is accepted

captions.instagram:
They signed. Now get the deposit.

Pick 25%, 50% or 100%, or set your own percent or amount, and the estimate shows the deposit due on acceptance. Your customer sees it right under the total when they sign.

Once it is accepted, a deposit invoice is created and their estimate page shows a Pay deposit button. Show them the QR code and they scan it with their phone camera to pay. Card payments need Stripe connected.

When you convert the estimate to the invoice, the paid deposit is credited on it.

Estimates are on the Professional plan and up. Start free at the link in bio

captions.instagram:
One contract. Billed in stages. Nothing billed twice.

Progress billing in Invoice My Clients lets you set a job up once: the client, the project, your retainage and a schedule of values with one line per stage. Then each application only needs the new % complete on each line.

Every application subtracts what you already billed, so nothing is billed twice. Retainage is held on every application, and Release retainage bills what was held in one step at the end.

Each application is a draft invoice. You review it and send it yourself.

Progress billing is on the Professional plan and up. Start free at the link in bio

Time tracking is on the Professional plan and up. Start free at the link in bio

New accounts start in ask-first mode. Each reminder waits with its exact wording until you approve it or skip it. Nothing reaches your client until you approve.

Set quiet hours, and reminders hold off during those hours in your client's local time.

Payment reminders are on the Professional plan and above. Start free at the link in bio
